### 2. MICE Diagnostics
#### 2.1. Model 1
```{r}
summary( mice_model_1 )
plot( mice_model_1 )

# visualize the distributions of imputed data
com <- complete( mice_model_1, action = 'long', include = TRUE )

ggplot( data = com[ !is.na( com$identity_change), ], # identity change
        aes( fill = identity_change, x = .imp ) ) + 
  geom_bar( position = "fill" ) + 
  scale_y_continuous( labels = scales::percent ) + 
  xlab( "Imputation number" ) + 
  ylab( "Percentage" ) + 
  scale_fill_discrete( name = "Identity Change" ) +
  theme( legend.justification = "bottom" )
```

#### 2.2. Model 2
```{r}
summary( mice_model_2 )
plot( mice_model_2 )

```
